name: coupon-card
title: Coupon card
description: A voucher: the offer, its code with a copy button, the conditions and the expiry, on a card with a perforated edge.
docs: offer is the headline on the stub ('20% off'), code the voucher code, description what it applies to and conditions the small print as a list behind a 'Details' disclosure. expiresAt is a date-only string such as '2026-10-29' (valid through the end of that day in timeZone) or a date-time; the card writes it out ('Expires in 3 days', 'Expires today', 'Expired 8 days ago') with the full date in a tooltip that hover, tap and keyboard focus open. Pass now from the server so the first render already says it; without it the card writes the plain date until the browser's clock is known, then switches. status is 'active', 'used' or 'expired': the last two mute the card, strike the code through and take the copy button away, and an active coupon past its date is shown as expired. onCopy(code) is called once the code is on the clipboard, and the copy button confirms through a polite live region. A code that does not fit beside the button keeps its letters together and the button drops under it; only a code longer than the whole row ever breaks. The notches are mask cut-outs, so the page shows through in light and dark. The layout follows the card's own width: stacked below 32rem, stub and body side by side above it. labels holds every fixed word.
